## About Newium
Newium is a lightweight, optimized Fabric modpack bringing enhanced visuals, smooth gameplay, and quality-of-life improvements, all built for peak performance.
## Features
- Carefully selected and tuned mods to maximize FPS, reduce lag, and ensure smooth gameplay—even on lower-end systems.
- Built on Fabric for faster load times, better mod compatibility, and a minimal performance footprint.
- Clean, modern visuals with optimized shaders support and refined graphical improvements, no unnecessary bloat.
- Improved texture blending for a more immersive and cohesive world without sacrificing performance.
